messages:
taylor: Quick alert — nightly snapshot rotation produced ~30 failed S3 PUTs. Error: 'MissingGrantToken / grant not found' referencing CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222333444555:key/0a1b2c3d.
sam: saw it at 01:12 UTC. uploader logs show retries then eventual 403.
nora: CloudTrail shows grant g-4c3b2 was created by infra-job on 2024-04-10 with TTL=3d. That TTL seems inappropriate for archive uploads.
taylor: We recently deployed template v2.1 that introduced short-lived grants for ephemeral restore flows. Looks like archive jobs also picked that up.
sre_lead: Short-term: create a new grant for the key and requeue failed snapshots. Mid-term: scope template changes so grant_ttl only applies to restore jobs. Long-term: add pre-rotation grant validation and an audit rule that flags grant TTLs < 30d for CMKs tagged persistence:archive.
security-bot: Compliance: manual grant creation must be recorded in SEC-2024-200 and CloudTrail evidence retained 90 days.
ops-bot: Requeue command executed, 28/30 uploads retried, 26 succeeded so far.
sam: Created manual grant: `aws kms create-grant --key-id 0a1b2c3d --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/backup-uploader --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name manual-rot-fix`
nora: I'll add a parser enhancement ticket to surface TTL reductions and emit an alert when a grant TTL < 30d is created for CMKs with tag archive=true.
taylor: I'll open the infra PR to exclude archive roles from grant_ttl default and add a CI lint rule.
sre_lead: Assign owners: taylor->infra PR, nora->audit parser, sam->incident ticket with CloudTrail IDs. Postmortem in 48h.
security-bot: Reminder: attach CloudTrail event IDs and the manual grant ARN to SEC-2024-200.
